title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation given is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This means that the predicted $$self_{rating}$$ is a linear function of $$critic_1$$. Think about how changes to $$critic_1$$ might affect the coefficients in this equation.

title: Effect of Dividing $$critic_1$$ by $$2$$
text: If you divide all values of $$critic_1$$ by $$2$$, consider how this affects the term $$\theta_1 critic_1$$ in the equation. What happens to the slope of the line represented by this equation?
